notes.title: Clarus Victoria's new game - Marble Age: Remastered!
notes.content:
We made a new game! Well, almost :)
Marble Age is a casual strategy about Ancient Greece, released back in 2014. It was good, but not great, so we decided to improve it!
Marble Age: Remastered will be released on November 3rd, 2020, and it's a whole new game:

 We fully upgraded the art style.
 We improved design and balance.
 New content! To the original two cities - Athens and Sparta - we added Corinth!


Take a look at the demo and if you like it, don't forget to add to your wishlist!

Marble Age: Remastered is participating in Steam Game Festival. Up until October 13th, we will make special streams every evening to show off the game and everything new about it. Tune in!

notes.title: How to translate a game into a baker's dozen of languages?
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278367/cf65fcee310fe20075c1977b3bce6bdc8ee9cd0f.jpg

Game localization is a very important, but not the most apparent step in game development. No matter how small your game is, a good translation can increase the number of potential buyers. On the other hand, a not so good translation can scare them off. Our games - Stone Age, Bronze Age, Marble Age, Predynastic Egypt and soon to be released Egypt: Old Kingdom are translated into 13 languages in general. We'll be glad to share our experience and talk about a few unexpected problems we had to deal with during localization.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278367/305d3dc1a5d7dea395ee21ac832c683ead04a487.png

The original language of our games is Russian, so the first step was to translate it into English. When our team still had only one member and when the first game, Stone Age, was created, there was no choice but to pay for translation. It wasn't the best choice not only because of money but also because translators-outsiders probably would not be aware of what game they are translating. It makes mistranslation possible. Thus, we decided to translate the next game, Marble Age, ourselves. The translation we made knew no proofreading, no editor's eye... well, you can guess how "great" this translation was. We got criticized for it a lot. Nevertheless, the goal was achieved - both games got translated into English. Later both translations were revised and edited by natives.

Now to get the game translated into English is only half a battle. It helps to attract more players among English-speakers, this includes people who speak other languages as well. Thanks to the fact that we put a lot of efforts in making our texts interesting and informative, we soon got many offers of help from people who wanted to translate our games to their languages! Needless to say, we were only happy to accept.

The first volunteer came from Spain, and Marble Age got its Spanish version. Since then our friend from Spain became one of our most supportive volunteers and helped to translate other games as well. Later another volunteer from Turkey appeared. Then another one from Germany. They all had to spend several weeks, helping us to localize our games. But as we all started to work together, we found out that our games are not designed to accommodate translations. These are basic problems we encountered:

1. Correct display of translated texts. Other languages can contain diacritics - special symbols which can be all around the letter, for example sometimes you can see the word "naïve" with two dots instead of one, or like in many French or Spanish words, like "Rêver" or "niño". The most extreme case of this problem, though, is when the new language is not Latin alphabet based, for example, Chinese or Hindi.

2. The screens of our games were designed to fit Russian language sentences. Sometimes when the text got translated into other languages, the length of a sentence changed, and it didn't fit into the screen anymore. Sometimes the translated sentence was too short, it also didn't look pretty.

This is how we shortened English words:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278367/bb2e7d3f2d1fd022c7453bcfd5b16e256bcf837e.png

German also didn't look very well:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278367/35d4409bb757a95ff25a588c7cb17a526137c28e.png

3. The most difficult problem was about words order. Every language has different sentence structure. For us, it was important because we like to replace some words with symbols for people, food, resources, etc. But in order to construct the correct sentence, all symbols must appear in the right places. During translation, words order was often messed up and we had troubles placing symbols in the right places. 

4. Finally, the text files exchange with translators was very inconvenient. For smaller games, like Bronze Age and Marble Age, it was bearable, but it didn't fit for a bigger game.

While working on Bronze Age and Marble Age localization, we were looking for solutions. We uploaded more fonts and language packs, adjusted some settings for encoding. We worked closely with translators, adjusting the length of sentences to fit the limited space on the screen. Later we came upon Crowdin  - a platform developed by Ukrainian programmer, which allows developers all over the world translate their applications, programs, games etc. with the help of volunteers. With the help of this platform, we slowly started to upgrade our localization process.

The first problem was solved relatively easy by uploading additional fonts and language packs. When Predynastic Egypt was created, we designed it with the thoughts of future translations. The text space was designed to extend automatically to adjust the text of any length.

Problem no.3 has solved thanks to a new text writing system, the idea of our programmer. We inserted text symbols everywhere where pictures should be inserted. For example, here is a short sentence: "The (number) dynasty came to power" we need to use different numbers. So we replaced it like this: "The {0} dynasty came to power", and this allows translators move the number around to suit the correct word order of their language. Here is the example of code, to give you a clearer idea of what we're talking about:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278367/473e5097c7df671c6cf24c9bfa655de3d8d8c6ae.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31278367/74c5b6faee7115b893c545f191cf0eaf355cfde1.jpg

The process of localization became much more convenient. Bronze Age already got several localizations by the time we uploaded it on Crowdin, and it helped us to improve translations and attract more volunteers for new localizations. Our games gained some popularity and we even got a small community of fans from different countries. Thanks to that we had a chance to start Predynastic Egypt translation early, and the game was released both in Russian and in English. English language translation was supported by a volunteer from the USA, whose input is especially appreciated due to his respectable age. It's nice to know that our game in interesting to many different people.

The translating platform also offers a convenient way to leave comments on suggested translations. Volunteers can always contact us or other translators to ask questions or to check something, and the work goes smooth and interesting.

After Predynastic Egypt was released, another volunteer joined our team. He was from China, and right away he brought with him a whole team of volunteers who started to translate Predynastic Egypt in Chinese! That was a huge luck because it let us sell our games on the Chinese market. As you probably know, Chinese-speaking countries make one of the largest game markets in the world, if not the largest. But it's almost impossible to sell there a game which has no Chinese translation. That's why the help of our Chinese friend was truly invaluable, and he keeps helping us and consulting us about China and Chinese market.

As the game was released, more and more volunteers offered their help. They not only translated Predynastic Egypt but also other games. Eventually, we had our games translated into 13 different languages, including French, Italian, Czech, Polish, Japanese and even Hindi! And this is not the limit, who knows where our future volunteers will come from!

The new game Egypt: Old Kingdom will be fully translated into English before the release, and we have French, Czech, Chinese, Spanish and Turkish translations in progress. Most of the translators are our long-time supporters, who translated previous games as well.

We're doing everything in our power to reward volunteers' input. We provide them all necessary support, issuing certificates for their CV, confirming their work, we share free game keys with them and put their names in subtitles. We'll certainly keep it up and we'll think of new ways to encourage them.

You're welcome to join our new project on Crowdin, especially if you can help us with German, Portuguese (Brasilian), Korean, Polish and Japanese languages.

And that's the essential information about our localization experience. If you have more questions, please don't hesitate to ask!

notes.title: Pre-Civilization Marble Age 2.9.6 + Pre-Civilization Egypt Release tomorrow!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7797787/b79d07273f1c25753eb4e08fd2914d0040587ab4.png
New Pre-Civilization Egypt Release in 24 hours!
The game focuses on the period from the beginning of the Neolithic in Upper Egypt in 5000 BC until the advent of the state in the year 3000 BC.
Add to youw wishlist http://store.steampowered.com/app/461620
The game is made with the informational support of The Center for Egyptological Studies of the Russian Academy of Sciences (CESRAS)

New update for Pre-Civilization Marble Age 2.9.6

Version 2.9.6
Added support for the 64 bit version of Adobe AIR (20+) on Mac OS X. This should fix the broken achievement system and some other bugs.
Fixed bug with trade sliders which appears sometimes after the fleet losses.
Fixed a bug when the all techs were researched, the science points were given.
Fixed a bug which allows to skip the Roman menace trial.
Fixed a bug with a double sound in pressing next turn button.
On hard difficulty the size of the Huns army decreased by approximately 20%.
The flickering effect (red contours around the button, etc.) been changed to slower blinking sequence.
Fixed a bug when the Hungry settlers event could appear twice per one turn.
Fixes in Russian, English and Spanish texts.

notes.title: Closed-beta Pre-Civilization Egypt invitation
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7797787/b79d07273f1c25753eb4e08fd2914d0040587ab4.png
About the new Pre-Civilization Egypt game
If you are good at English, we would like to invite you to take part in the selection of testers for closed-beta test of the game about Ancient Egypt. Final name of the game is Pre-Civilization Egypt! ːsteamhappyː

The game focuses on the period from the beginning of the Neolithic in Upper Egypt in 5000 BC until the advent of the state in the year 3000 BC.

The game is made with the informational support of The Center for Egyptological Studies of the Russian Academy of Sciences (CESRAS)

Everything in the game as scientific authentical as possible within a modern reconstruction of predynastic Egypt. Here are some pictures:

City:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7797787/dc208e5591887d61525b43d9a594f3f2443fbec5.png

Buildings:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7797787/cbe8c0562ec29c11ab9a090794f49c0d62a2f00d.png

Egypt:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7797787/fe5bd19b8e83e2cf122e66a6019e0b48e9caf778.png

Technologies:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7797787/7545fe9ad803fdb6bb7723fd2a403d778e8d1a03.png

Cults:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7797787/3fccf16d2a423433a75308e56669065b22399d08.png

Test conditions
The game is in the beta-test mode and in the most basic English localization, so there are very important conditions that you need to accept before you send your request:
[olist]
English is your native language or you are very good at it or it’s a part of your profession – you are an editor, journalist, writer, etc.
The game has bugs, bad texts and this is normal thing. We had together polish everything – for example, indicate a bad text and suggest a proper fix.
While you testing, very important to carefully read everything and, when necessary, to write proper suggestions. If you are willing to help with testing, but not ready to follow all of the following instructions, you'd better wait for the release of the full game.
During testing, you should not just play the game: while playing you must record the video (once game screen, without the voice), look for bugs and write about found bugs and text suggestion in TXT-document. All comments in txt-document must be written a specific format (detailed instructions see below).
You agree that you will not distribute the game or video and any other material or information which you receive at the time of testing, to any third parties or persons. Even to your friend, if he is not a tester. While testing, the game has non-final quality and we don't want to spoil the impression of the other people.
[/olist]
Reward
[olist]
Your reward for good and successful work:
Digital version of the game after the release: Steam version for PC/MAC, or mobile, when we will test it.
At your request, we can add your name to the credits of the creators of the game.
You will be able to make the project better, offering some cool text suggestions (if they really are good and won't hurt historical aspects).
[/olist]
How it works

If you agree, below is the description of how it will work:
The testing will be held in the closed group in Steam Community. There you can download the latest version of the game, inform us about results and communicate with other testers.
Before testing, you will get the latest version for time-limited test (2 days), after that we immediately expect you to post the video + comments into sprecial thread.
Very important to record each of your game sessions and send it to us. Each video will be analyzed, we will see all the oddities, bugs, text issues, etc. "How" we will describe in closed group.

Questionnaire for your request
If we didn't scare you, and you are ready to start testing, you need to fill out a short questionnaire which will help us to understand the specialty of your testing: 
[olist]
How old are you? 
Your native language?
Do you work professionally with texts?
Have you played any games of Pre-civilization series earlier? If Yes, please specify which ones.
Did you play the demo version of Egypt?
Configuration of your PC: OS version, RAM, screen resolution, CPU model, video card model (with memory).
Do you have any knowledge of the history of Egypt or the Ancient world in addition to the school curriculum?
Link to your Steam profile so we can send you a friend request and invite to a closed group, if we select you as the tester.
[/olist]
You can write you request it in this thread. The request is not a guarantee that you will become a tester, by reading your request we are going to judge how clearly you can follow the instructions.

The testing will be held in the closed group in Steam Community. There you can download the latest version of the game, inform us about results and communicate with other testers.
Before testing, you will get the latest version for time-limited test (2 days), after that we immediately expect you to post the video + comments into sprecial thread.
Very important to record each of your game sessions and send it to us. Each video will be analyzed, we will see all the oddities, bugs, text issues, etc. "How" we will describe in closed group.

Questionnaire for your request
If we didn't scare you, and you are ready to start testing, you need to fill out a short questionnaire which will help us to understand the specialty of your testing: 
[olist]
How old are you? 
Your native language?
Do you work professionally with texts?
Have you played any games of Pre-civilization series earlier? If Yes, please specify which ones.
Did you play the demo version of Egypt?
Configuration of your PC: OS version, RAM, screen resolution, CPU model, video card model (with memory).
Do you have any knowledge of the history of Egypt or the Ancient world in addition to the school curriculum?
Link to your Steam profile so we can send you a friend request and invite to a closed group, if we select you as the tester.
[/olist]
You can write you request it in this thread. The request is not a guarantee that you will become a tester, by reading your request we are going to judge how clearly you can follow the instructions.

notes.title: Version 2.8.6 -Changed the mechanism of stats count + some bugfixes
notes.content:
Changed the mechanism for stats modifiers. Now modifiers do not apply to the whole stat, but for each source of stat alone (production in the city, trade, etc.). Each modifier are now charges only if the increase of the stat’s source is positive. It fixes a number of strange bugs found in events or trade. For example, if there is a bonus + 50% production and you try to sell it, than the number sold production also increased by 50%.
Increased precision of the stats for large numbers - rounding occurs to smaller digit, to avoid the some problematic situations. For example, when production number written is sufficient for the construction, but you cannot build it.
Changed window for stat description details. The effects of events, technologies, and exploration are now give only the bonuses that they generate, plus added other bonuses that generated by events and technologies, such as bonus from Byzantium, technology Philosopher's Stone, Colossus, etc.
Small changes in the German text.
Fixed a bug due to which after the construction of Level 1 Houses, there was a text in description that building requires one gold for maintenances, but maintenance was free.
Fixed a bug with sound and music icons status in main menu, when icons remained unchanged, even when sound and music were switched off in the options during the game.


Версия 2.8.6 - изменен механизм подсчета статов + исправлены некоторые ошибки
Переделан механизм начисления модификаторов для статов. Теперь модификаторы применяются не ко всему стату, а для каждого источника стата в отдельности (производство в городе, торговля и т.п.). И теперь каждый модификатор начисляются только если прирост источника стата положительный. Это исправляет ряд странных багов, встречающихся в событиях или торговле. Например, если есть бонус +50% к приросту продукции и попробовать продавать её, то кол-во продаваемой продукции так же увеличивалось на 50%.
Повышена точность отображения статов, для больших цифр округление происходит в меньшую сторону что бы не было ситуации, когда, например, продукции написано, что достаточно для постройки, а построить нельзя.
Переработаны окно описание деталей статов. Эффекты от событий, технологий и разведки теперь дают только те бонусы, которые они сами генерируют, плюс в них же добавлены другие вещи, которые генерирует события и технологии, например, Бонус от Византии, технологии Философского камня, Колосса и т.п.
Небольшие правки в Немецких текстах.
Исправлен баг из-за которого после постройки домов 1-го уровня было описание что дома требуют 1 золото на содержание, хотя содержания не требовалось.
Исправлен баг, что в главном меню не обновлялось состояние иконок звука и музыки даже в ситуации, когда состояние звука и музыка были изменены в опциях во время игры.

notes.title: Версия 2.6 - оптимизация экрана, дополнительные ходы + трейдинг карты на ревью в Стим (скоро!)
notes.content:
Версия 2.6



Добавлена возможность продолжить игру после победы в игре. Возможность не позволяет прокачивать город бесконечно как в “Бронзовом Веке”, но теперь достаточно времени что бы закончить свои дела.

Произведена оптимизация игрового экрана. Для разрешений, на которых игра запускается с черными блоками по краям, вставлен греческий орнамент.

Исправлен баг, если при объединении Греции продолжить игра за Спартанское царство, то давали линию заданий за Афины, теперь корректно дают за Спарту.

Игрок теперь получает 1 торговца назад всякий раз когда рвется торговля с городом.

Прирост чумы в ход ослаблен для легкой (на 50%) и средней (на 25%) сложности.

Кол-во войск Римлян стало меньше на легкой и средней сложности на 25%.

У Афин кол-во доступных послов на обоих картах стало примерно на 25% больше.

Требования по поселенцам для второй карты за Спарту снижены, теперь легче объединить мир в конце игры.

Исправлен баг из-за которого в некоторых ситуациях независимые города и страны на карте имели флаг игрока.

Исправлен баг из-за которого Пелла не участвовала в отражении Персов, максимум что делала это посылала 20% своих сил если она была в союзе с Игроком. Силы Персов соответственно так же были увеличены примерно на 500 воинов.

Исправлен баг когда Христианская конверсия была успешной даже с 0% шансом. Оставался все равно шанс 1%.

Исправлен баг когда после провальной атаки на Скифов, засчитывали проигрыш, но атака Скифов по-прежнему висела в виде дебафа.

Трейдинг карты Стима на ревью и будут скоро доступны

Несколько различных фиксов в русской и английской версии текста.

notes.title: Version 2.6 - screen optimization, additional turns + trading cards (soon!)
notes.content:
Version 2.6


Added the possibility to continue playing after winning the game. You will not be able to play this game in Sandbox mode like in "Bronze Age", but you will have enough time to finish the things you would like to.

Optimization of the game screen. For resolutions where the game starts with black blocks on the edges, now inserted Greek ornament.

Fixed bug when after the unification of Greece player chose to play as the Spartan kingdom, the quest line was for Athens. Now it’s for Sparta as it must be normally.

The player now receives 1 trader back whenever he breaks trade route with any city.

The Plague growth rate weakened for easy mode by 50% and for normal mode by 25%.

The total amount if the Roman troops now less by 25% for normal and easy modes.

Athens possible total amount of envoys increased by 25% for both maps.

The requirements for the settlers players have to meet (for Sparta) in the last part of game are decreased and it is now much easier to unite the world.

Fixed bug when, in some situations, an independent city or the country on the map had a Player’s flag.

Fixed bug when Pella did not help to repel the Persians, sending only 20% of its forces when was allied with player (But the Persian forces were also increased by approximately 500 warriors).

Fixed bug when conversion to Christianity was successful even with 0% chance (1% chance remained).

Fixed bug when after the failed attack on the Scythians, counted as trial failure, but the “Scythians Invasion” still remained as debuff.

Trade cards and badges are ready for Steam review.

Several typos fixes in Russian and English versions of the text.

notes.title: Версия 2.5 - Доступна Мак версия игры + пожелания игроков + фиксы
notes.content:
Версия 2.5

Крупное изменение

+ В Стиме стала доступна Мак версия игры.

Исправление ошибок


 Теперь если игрок, играя за Спарту и находясь под Римом, дожил до раскола Римской Империи, то все предыдущие задания будут корректно отменены.
 Теперь если игрок отменяет контратаку против Гуннов, то это не приводит более к провалу испытания. 
 Исправлен баг, изза которого если игрок продавал воинов не имел их, торговля рвалась. Теперь торговля рвется только если он продаёт более 0 воинов которых не имеет.
 Исправлен баг, изза которого в полноэкранной версии нельзя было поменять имя правителя.


Пожелания игроков


 Перебалансированы цены для Тех после 25 уровня на первой карте, последняя технология теперь не должна стоить сотни миллионов очков.
 В момент появления Чумы у города игрока все текущие атаки против него останавливаются, и минимальные отношения повышаются до 3, по окончанию чумы все другие города так же теряют 25% населения.
 Добавление в главном меню кнопки выхода из игры.
 Отключение кнопки ESC в полноэкранном режиме, что бы игра из полного экрана не вываливалась в черное окно.


Иные исправления


 В опциях кнопка Выхода переименована на Сохранить и Выйти.
 Изменение порядка кнопок в опциях.
 Исправление пары опечаток текста в русской версии игры.

+ В Стиме стала доступна Мак версия игры.

Исправление ошибок


 Теперь если игрок, играя за Спарту и находясь под Римом, дожил до раскола Римской Империи, то все предыдущие задания будут корректно отменены.
 Теперь если игрок отменяет контратаку против Гуннов, то это не приводит более к провалу испытания. 
 Исправлен баг, изза которого если игрок продавал воинов не имел их, торговля рвалась. Теперь торговля рвется только если он продаёт более 0 воинов которых не имеет.
 Исправлен баг, изза которого в полноэкранной версии нельзя было поменять имя правителя.


Пожелания игроков


 Перебалансированы цены для Тех после 25 уровня на первой карте, последняя технология теперь не должна стоить сотни миллионов очков.
 В момент появления Чумы у города игрока все текущие атаки против него останавливаются, и минимальные отношения повышаются до 3, по окончанию чумы все другие города так же теряют 25% населения.
 Добавление в главном меню кнопки выхода из игры.
 Отключение кнопки ESC в полноэкранном режиме, что бы игра из полного экрана не вываливалась в черное окно.


Иные исправления


 В опциях кнопка Выхода переименована на Сохранить и Выйти.
 Изменение порядка кнопок в опциях.
 Исправление пары опечаток текста в русской версии игры.

notes.title: Version 2.5 Update (Mac version + player wishes + fixes)
notes.content:
Version 2.5

Major change
 The Mac version of the game is available for Steam users.

Fixed bugs. 

 Playing as Sparta under the Roman’s rule, if the player survived till the Fall of the Roman Empire, all of the previous tasks will be properly cancelled.
 If player cancels a counter-attack against the Huns, it does not lead to failure of the trial. 
 If the player tried to sell the warriors he did not own – trade rout was broken. Now trading breaks only if he sells more than 0 warriors he did not have.
 Fixed bug «impossible to change the name of the ruler in full screen mode».


Players’ wishes

 Rebalanced culture costs for Techs after 25 level, the latest technology now cost less (not “millions” as before).
 During the Plague even, all attacks against him stopped. All “grudge-hate” relations are increasing to 3. At the end of the Plague, all other cities also lose 25% of the population.
 Added “Quit game” in main menu.
 Disabled ESC button function in full screen mode, to prevent the “black box” situation.


Other fixes

 “Quit game” button in options menu renamed to “Save and Exit”.
 Change the order of buttons in the options.
 Fixed a couple of typos in Russian version of the game.

notes.title: Обновление до версии 2.4. (Добавлен режим Полный экран, пофиксен фриз и другое)
notes.content:
Добавлена возможность игры в полноэкранном режиме. Кнопка переключатель доступна в главном или игровом меню.

 На Легкой сложности стало еще легче. Гунны и Арабы вырезают значительно меньше народу в случаи провальных боёв.

 Исправлен краш когда из-за атаки вражеской коалиции, при попытке замириться, игра крашилась.

 Исправлен баг из-за которого если объединить Грецию под управлением Рима, то после раскола последнего будет предложено второй раз объединить Грецию.

 Если в момент падение Рима игрок торгует с ним, то Торговец будет возвращен.

 Исправлен текст английской версии CLOSE VICTORY на CLOSE DEFEAT

notes.title: Update version 2.4. (Added Fullscreen more + fixed "buttonfreeze" and more)
notes.content:
Added Full screen mode. See the button in main menu and game options.

  Easy mode has become even easier. In cases of failed battles, the Huns and Arabs kills much less population.

  Fixed crash (button freeze) when you trying to make peace with enemy coalition during their attack.

  Fixed bug: if unite Greece under the Rome’s rule, than after the Fall of the Rome you’ll be asked to unite the Greece again.

  When you have a trade route with Rome, after the Fall of the Rome – trader will be returned.

  Fixed English version text CLOSE VICTORY to CLOSE DEFEAT

notes.title: SPARTA CAMPAIGN BETA-TEST 17-20 FEBRUARY
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I’d like to announce the beginning of the beta-test for Sparta Campaign (Pre-Civilization Marble Age)! (PC version!)
The test will start tomorrow in the evening at FGL.com If you would like to be the beta-tester please send me your email (to clarusvictoria@gmail.com ) or just write it here in the thread and I’ll give you access to the game (link by email). Only 49 test accounts available!
Test will begin 17 of February (evening CET) and will end 20 of February.

After that please drop a few lines about the game right to the thread or send by email to clarusvictoria@gmail.com : 

• First impression - just in your own words.
• What is the most you liked or disliked playing Sparta Campaign? Were there any glitches or bugs? 
• If caught any bugs or errors - describe them or tell me how to find them (preferably with the screens or saves with the bugged turns). 
• Please, write a few lines about game balance - what seemed strange or not makes sense (constructions, technologies, the solutions for events).

Have fun!

notes.title: БЕТА-ТЕСТ СПАРТЫ 17-20 февраля
notes.content:
Приветствуем всех! У нас отличная новость!

Мы начинаем бета-тест СПАРТЫ.

Он начнется завтра вечером (17 Февраля) и продлится только 3 дня.

Выслать отчет надо будет 20 февраля на почту clarusvictoria@gmail.com . Отчет является необходимым условием для участия в бета-тесте.

Тест будет проходить на FGL.com и чтобы принять в нем участие надо отправить мне сообщение с адресом вашей электронной почты. Ссылка с доступом к игре придет на указанный мэйл.

20 февраля, поиграв за Спарту, надо будет прислать отчет со следующими отзывами:
1. Первое впечатление – просто своими словами.
2. Что больше всего понравилось или не понравилось? Были ли какие-нибудь глюки или тормоза?
3. Если попались на глаза баги или ошибки – опишите их или скажите как их найти (лучше всего со скринами или приготовить сейвы с ошибкой именно на том ходе когда она произошла).
4. Очень нужно ваше мнение по балансу – что показалось не сбалансированным или не имеющим смысл (постройки, технологии, варианты решений в событиях).

Спасибо всем и удачной игры!
